name: shared-rules
description: Shared Claude rules for every session - loads a set of rules into context at session start: the rules bundled with each plugin version by default, or your own rules repo with updates applied automatically or only after you approve them.

rules_repo.title: Rules repository
rules_repo.description: Git URL of your own rules repo (its rules/ folder is loaded). Leave empty to use the rules bundled with this plugin.

update_mode.title: Rule updates
update_mode.description: For your own rules repo. ask: new or changed rules wait until you approve them in a session. auto: they load as soon as they are published.
